Mia: Hey CS team — Atlas (EU, mid-market) requested a three-part enablement: prod-ready onboarding, prompt best-practices + evals, ops/runbook + rollback drills. Need CET-friendly times and two facilitators per session.
Samir: CET mornings please. Recordings mandatory; US folks will be late.
Jordan_CS: Attendee mix: ~12 eng, 3 PMs, 2 infra. Breakouts OK but need facilitator coverage.
Devon: Proposal: (1) Core Onboarding 2h, (2) Prompt guardrails + evals 90m, (3) Ops/runbook + drills 60m. Spread over two weeks so they can apply learnings.
Mia: Proposed CET slots (vote): Tue 9 Jun 09:30-11:30 CET — Onboarding; Thu 11 Jun 09:00-10:30 CET — Prompts; Tue 16 Jun 10:00-11:00 CET — Ops. Poll: https://doodle.com/poll/atlas-enable and form for timezone prefs.
Samir: I'll set recording and upload folder; will add short feedback form (5 q + free text) to capture latency/cost/rollout concerns.
AlexR: I'll own ops doc and lead rollback breakout A. Devon — can you run troubleshooting breakout B?
Devon: Yes. I'll prepare two hands-on labs (KV priming, batching) and slides. Due Jun 2.
Jordan_CS: I'll request test prompts and payloads from Atlas by May 28 to seed labs.
maia-support: I can float — available Jun 9 & Jun 11 CET mornings.
Mia: Great. Action list: Jordan_CS collect prompts (May 28), Devon lab assets + deck (Jun 2), AlexR ops doc + breakout plan (Jun 2), Samir recordings + invites + drive path (Jun 4).
Onboard-bot: Calendar poll created by Mia — https://calendar.redwood.com/p/xyz (3 votes so far).
